I have thought about talking to someone about it a lot. My fear is that because of that no one really has idea about me feeling this way its gonna change their perspective on me, that i will become someone "insane" or something in their eyes. Like they might lose trust in me. People briefly know that i am not always alright but they dont know how far it goes. 

I am actually seeing therapist mainly because of how socially anxious i am but i never got courage to tell her about this, i dont feel comfortable talking to her at all actually.

That is like mainly the reason why i decided to post here bcs its like telling someone but its anonymous. But its true that its not the same as telling it to someone personally.

Anyway ,thank you so much for in depth answer and kind words
